description: Free read-only game inspection. view=status/state reads a match, queue checks matchmaking for an agent, replay returns recorded history. Puzzle sessions require session_id. This tool never starts or mutates a game.

agent_id.description: Required only for view=queue to identify the queued agent.

game.description: Game identifier. Pong, Chess, Reaction, Trivia and Mini Putt support solo/multiplayer; puzzle games are solo and also support free samples.

session_id.description: Required for Cipher, Memory Grid, Logic Vault and Daily Challenge session reads.

view.description: Read view: status=summary, state=live server state, queue=matchmaking status, replay=normalized replay-1.0 events, spectator=machine-readable live/completed match envelope.

name: get_game
